name: currency-collapse-video
description: Remotion video for The 2030 Currency Collapse

scripts.test: npm run test:custom-film && npm run test:motion-library && npm run test:showcase && npm run test:documentary
scripts.test:motion-library: npm run generate:motion-audio && rm -rf .motion-test-build && tsc -p tsconfig.motion-test.json && node --test tests/motion-library.test.cjs
scripts.test:showcase: npm run generate:showcase-staged && rm -rf .showcase-test-build && tsc -p tsconfig.showcase-test.json && node --test tests/showcase.test.cjs
scripts.render:motion-preview: npm run generate:motion-audio && remotion render MotionLibraryPreview out/motion-library-preview.mp4 --concurrency=1
scripts.render:showcase-proof: npm run generate:motion-audio && remotion render StoryEngineCustomFilmShowcase out/storyengine-showcase-proof.mp4 --concurrency=1
scripts.render:showcase-staged-proof: npm run generate:showcase-staged && remotion render StoryEngineCustomFilmShowcaseStagedProof out/showcase-staged-proof.mp4 --frames=0-119 --concurrency=1
scripts.render:showcase-source-clip-proof: npm run generate:showcase-staged && remotion render StoryEngineCustomFilmShowcaseSourceClipProof out/showcase-source-clip-proof.mp4 --frames=0-119 --concurrency=1
scripts.render:director-scene-proof: npm run generate:director-scene-proof && remotion render StoryEngineDirectorSceneControlProof out/director-scene-control-proof.mp4 --concurrency=1 --gl=angle
